title: 2026 F-gas trifluoromethane by-product recovery and import declaration QA

sources.title: Bans on F gas in new products and equipment: current and future
Fluorinated gas (F gas): guidance for users, producers and traders

facts.source_fact: When manufacturing F gases in Great Britain, trifluoromethane produced as a by-product must be recovered or destroyed.
The by-product rule includes trifluoromethane arising during manufacture of feedstocks for F-gas production.
Importers must obtain a declaration from the producer where trifluoromethane is a manufacturing by-product.
The producer declaration must state that the trifluoromethane was recovered or destroyed.
The declaration must accompany import paperwork.
The import duty applies to F gases entering Great Britain under the described manufacturing-by-product condition.
The rule is separate from HFC quota allocation requirements.
facts.expected_handling: Do not conflate by-product proof with quota.

facts.source_fact: The rule is separate from equipment leak-check duties.
facts.expected_handling: Do not conflate production evidence with operational monitoring.

facts.source_fact: A declaration is evidence of required treatment, not a measured amount of emissions avoided.
Feedstock-related by-product language must be retained when evaluating applicability.
facts.expected_handling: Do not narrow scope to final F-gas manufacture only.
